# Owned Map

> Owned Map is a web app that gets you customers from LinkedIn on autopilot. You paste your website; it gives you the LinkedIn searches for your buyers, a Chrome extension reads the posts you open, an AI scores how ready each person is to buy (0 to 100), and shows them on an interactive world map with what they wrote and a reply you can copy.

Owned Map is a paid subscription product with a 7-day free trial (card required, charged only when the trial ends). Nothing is ever posted, sent or clicked on the user's behalf: every reply is edited and sent by the user.

## What it does
- Reads your website and works out what you sell, who buys it and the phrases buyers use.
- Searches public posts (Hacker News today; LinkedIn through a browser extension that reads only what the user has on screen) and scores each person from 0 to 100, labelling the intent: asks for a recommendation, complains about a competitor, asks about price, looks for an alternative, or describes the problem.
- Places each lead on a Globe or Country map when the post or the author's public profile says where they are; the rest are listed.
- Drafts a reply in the user's tone for strong leads, tracks status (new, contacted, replied, customer) and the history, and exports leads as CSV.
- Shares a read-only view of the leads through a private link that can expire or be turned off.

## Pricing
- $47 per month includes 75 leads a month with a score of 70 or more (3 packs of 25). Each extra pack of 25 leads costs $15 for packs 4 to 10, $10 for packs 11 to 25 and $5 from the 26th, up to 100 packs, which is 2,500 leads (25 packs: $302 a month, 100 packs: $677 a month).
- Yearly billing is 30% less than monthly.
- 7-day free trial.
